section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments used in the present study: Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), ASI-R (short form), SATAQ-4, Connectedness to Nature Scale (CNS), Nature Exposure Scale (NES), and Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), with reported internal consistency values for women and men. Demographic items collected included sex, age, race, education, marital status, and self-reported height and weight (used to compute BMI). The section does not report sample size, country, recruitment source, participant ages, racial composition, education percentages, mean BMI, survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
